name: ada-audit-scripts
description: Read-only accessibility audit helpers (WCAG 2.2 AA candidates) built on Playwright, axe-core and the Guidepup Virtual Screen Reader. Not a compliance certification.

scripts.smoke:live: node inventory.mjs --urls examples/urls.txt --out ./audit-output && node axe-scan.mjs --urls examples/urls.txt --widths 390 --out ./audit-output && node bypass-order.mjs --urls examples/urls.txt --widths 390 --out ./audit-output && node journeys.mjs --urls examples/urls.txt --personas keyboard,sr --budget 30 --out ./audit-output
